newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks reduce gains after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks reduce gains after U.S. data.

text.p: French shares reduced their gains after the release of U.S. January durable goods data which showed a 3.6 percent rise, more than twice the expected rate.
But after falling to around 2,616, the CAC blue-chip index picked up steam again.

The CAC-40 index was up 18.25 points or 0.7 percent at 2,620.39 at 1339 GMT, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,623 from 2,603 on Wednesday's close. Before the data, the index stood at 2,620.84.
Wall Street is expected to open higher.
